# Prebuilt firmware

| File | Version | Use and validation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JP226-GPS-IMU-Logger.bin` | v0.19 | Cardputer app image for Launcher; built for `m5stack-stamps3`, flashed and boot-tested on Cardputer v1. |
| `JP226-GPS-IMU-Logger-factory.bin` | v0.19 | Cardputer merged bootloader, partitions and app for direct USB flashing at offset `0x0`; generated by the same build. |
| `JP226-GPS-IMU-Logger-core2-factory.bin` | v0.16 | Retained older Core2 image; not rebuilt or tested with the v0.19 changes. |

The Cardputer images are the unchanged artifacts from the successful
2026-10-31 build and upload. Their FOSSIL RECORD commit field is `nogit`
because the build came from a downloaded source archive.

The v0.19 host protocol, reader, Wi-Fi and CSV tests pass. The Ranger TPMS
queries remain experimental: live tyre pressure and temperature readings
have not been verified on the vehicle. Only Wi-Fi ELM327 adapters are
supported; Bluetooth/BLE support is not implemented.

Check the binaries from this directory with:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```
